option_relations.rationale: Histopathologic examination did not show melanocytic lesions, which are characteristic of subungual melanoma.
Longitudinal Melanonychia typically presents with melanocytic lesions, which were not observed in the histopathologic examination.
The histopathologic findings of bland spindle cell proliferation within the nail matrix and villous fibroepithelial projections into the nail plate are consistent with Onychomatricoma.
Pigmented onychomatricoma is a subtype of Onychomatricoma, and the presence of pigment in the lesion is consistent with this diagnosis.
